feedback_note: Nine valid review entries came from 2 readers. They continue to favor women’s fashion, official sources, and deeper women-led organization profiles, while asking for fewer beginner explainers and small-event pieces. A comment said a local community event framed as a weekend habit was not useful. This edition balances a timely PPA preview, a Chinese court-fashion collaboration report, and official paddle-certification news.
feedback_note_zh: 本期参考了2位读者的9条有效评价。大家继续关注女性球场时尚、官方信息和女性主导组织的深度介绍，同时希望减少入门知识和小型活动报道。有读者认为，把本地社群活动包装成周末习惯的内容帮助不大。本期安排了PPA赛事前瞻、中国女性球场服饰合作报道，以及官方球拍认证信息。

stories.title: Daytona Beach PPA Open draws are out: what to watch next week
stories.title_zh: 代托纳海滩PPA公开赛签表公布：下周看点一览
stories.summary: The PPA Tour’s Proton Daytona Beach Open runs Nov. 16–22 at Pictona at Holly Hill, with all five pro-division draws released. The event guide lists 1,000 ranking points per division and spotlights Anna Leigh Waters and Rachel Rohrabacher. The Round of 16 begins Thursday, Nov. 19 on PickleballTV; earlier qualifying and rounds stream on the PPA Tour’s YouTube channel.
stories.summary_zh: PPA巡回赛 Proton 代托纳海滩公开赛将于11月16日至22日在佛罗里达州 Holly Hill 的 Pictona 举行，五个职业组别的签表均已公布。赛事指南显示，各组冠军可获1,000个排名积分，并重点介绍了 Anna Leigh Waters 和 Rachel Rohrabacher。16强赛将于11月19日周四在 PickleballTV 播出；此前的资格赛和前几轮可通过PPA巡回赛 YouTube 频道观看。
stories.why: A timely guide to this PPA Tour stop gives readers the dates, stakes, featured players, and where to follow the matches.
stories.why_zh: 这份及时的赛事指南整理了PPA站赛的日期、积分、焦点球员和观赛渠道，方便读者安排关注。
stories.source: Pickleball.com · Hannah Johns; PPA Tour event guide

stories.title: A Hong Kong player brings her own ideas to pickleball apparel
stories.title_zh: 香港球员陈庭欣参与设计匹克球服饰联名系列
stories.summary: A report republished by Beijing News says Hong Kong entertainer and pickleball player Tong Ting Yan (陳庭欣) is working with brand Lance Board on a co-designed apparel line. She said she had found mostly tennis clothing when looking for pickleball-specific women’s wear. The design team describes a concept inspired by her parrots, with soft purple and blue, ballet details, and light mesh. Final product plans have not yet been announced.
stories.summary_zh: 新京报转载日照新闻网的报道说，香港艺人兼匹克球爱好者陈庭欣正与兰斯博合作设计服饰系列。她表示，自己寻找女性匹克球专用服装时，接触到的大多是网球服。设计团队介绍，系列灵感来自她饲养的鹦鹉，采用浅紫、浅蓝色调，并融入芭蕾元素和轻盈网纱。具体产品安排尚未公布。
stories.why: The report connects a player’s real apparel needs with a concrete design process, while showing that the collection is still in development.
stories.why_zh: 报道把球员实际的服装需求与具体设计过程联系起来，也说明该系列仍在开发中。
stories.source: 新京报（转载日照新闻网）

stories.title: USA Pickleball removes two CPX paddle models from its certified list
stories.title_zh: 美国匹克球协会将两款CPX球拍移出认证名单
stories.summary: USA Pickleball says compliance testing found significant differences in PBCoR and deflection values between the CPX Hyper+ 14mm and 16mm models submitted for certification and the mass-produced units sold to consumers. The organization removed both models from its certified list and says it is working with CPX on new versions under a new model name. Players can consult the current approved-equipment list for status.
stories.summary_zh: 美国匹克球协会表示，合规测试发现，送检认证的 CPX Hyper+ 14mm 和 16mm 球拍与面向市场销售的量产产品，在 PBCoR 和形变数值上存在显著差异。协会已将这两个型号移出认证名单，并称正与 CPX 合作，以新型号名称提交改版球拍。球员应查看最新的认证器材名单确认状态；这份声明没有宣布全面禁止休闲场合使用。
stories.why: Certification status can matter to tournament players and paddle buyers; the official notice explains what changed and points readers to the current list.
stories.why_zh: 认证状态可能影响参赛球员和选购球拍的人；这份官方通知说明了变动，并指向最新名单。
